item.title: Clean Sweep 0.6.2 Preview
item.description:
# Clean Sweep 0.6.2 Preview
- **Process each photo in one visit.** Clean Sweep checks saved marks and file availability, then validates and generates each marked photo's removals before moving on. The separate scan through the photos is gone. - **Progress follows the remaining work.** Estimates adjust for undone marks, already-generated removals, and unavailable files as each photo is checked. - **Stop After Photo keeps the rest queued.** All pending removals and final validation on the current photo finish before stopping. Resume skips completed photos.
Existing repair protection, recovery snapshots, and checks for confirmed generated results remain in place. Separate removal pins still generate sequentially. Your saved brush choice, queue records, and update settings carry forward.
This remains a preview. Automated tests cover the new processing flow, stop/resume, older queues, and uncertain results. Native Lightroom testing and performance measurement of this change are still pending.
Finish or stop your batch and close the floating window before replacing the complete `RemovalQueue.lrplugin` folder. Reload the plug-in in Plug-in Manager; if Lightroom retains old scripts or menus, fully quit and reopen it. Check for Updates opens a download notice; installation remains manual.
